points_of_interest.name: Vaux le Vicomte
points_of_interest.description: Can be booked via the website or by calling +33-1-64144199. Audio guides available. The round trip is approximately 14 km, but involves a steep climb (and descent). This excursion is optional. http://www.vaux-le-vicomte.com
